_schema_notes: Phase-1 NPC roster for milestones M3/M4/M6. See master_prompt.md 'NPCs - start with one' and 'The Core 60'. Shape mirrors npcs_backlog.json.
_only_present: Wren, Fungal Brood Mother, Vord Drone, Vord Raider, Graze, Cluck, Thornback. Everything else stays in npcs_backlog.json until M6+ expansion phases.

name: Wren
desc: The first Kin you rescue (M6 / Act 1). Quiet for most of Act 1; the moral hinge of Act 3 in later milestones. For M6 acceptance: she follows the player home from the M6 stronghold encounter, lives at the base, and comments on the player's discoveries via the Spirit Gateway link.
appearance: Young Kin, mid-twenties. Pale, with dark hair down past her shoulders. Wears the clothes you find her in: a torn working dress, sturdy boots. Eyes deep brown, often looking down.
behaviors: Follows the player back to base after rescue.
Speaks short hand-authored lines at scripted moments.
Stays at the base.
Reads the Discovery Log and comments on weird synergies.
abilities: Gates the Spirit Gateway unlock (M6 final step).

name: Fungal Brood Mother
desc: Act 1 boss for M6. Lurks in the hand-placed stronghold. Tier 1 - designed to validate the multi-path boss framework at the smallest scale: a frontal weak point, a glowing back weak point, vulnerability to poison bait. Players who explored the synergy sandbox in M2 should find multiple paths to victory.
appearance: Bloated, slow Kin matriarch overgrown with bioluminescent fungal sacs. Her face is partially preserved, eyes blank but tracking. Trails spore-mist as she moves.
behaviors: Stays mostly stationary, rarely chases.
Spawns 'Spore Mites' (small fast adds) every ~15 seconds.
Telegraphs sac-burst attacks 2 seconds before triggering.
Becomes more aggressive below 30% HP, releases panic spore-cloud.
Glowing back weak point exposed during sac-burst windup.
Vulnerable to poison bait (a 'weird path' kill validated in M6).
abilities: Spore-Sac Burst - AOE poison cloud, leaves lingering damage zone
Tendril Lash - short-range pull toward her
Death Bloom - final ability, releases all stored spores
drops: Spirit Anchor (her Kin memory) - required to insert at the Spirit Gateway in M6
Glandular Sac (future Cheese Press / chem set ingredient)

name: Vord Drone
desc: M3 fodder - the single enemy used to validate the combat-feels-good acceptance test. Must take a clean hit, react with flinch + ragdoll on death, react to crouch-aimed headshots. No NavMesh - uses the existing lidar-based AI on marching-cubes terrain.
appearance: Hunched humanoid in tattered work clothes. Skin grey-purple, eyes filmed over. Slow shuffling gait, weak limbs.
behaviors: Slow approach, swings clumsily.
Easily killed individually; dangerous in groups.
Reacts to hit with flinch + ragdolls on death.
Tends to clump near the boss for support.

name: Vord Raider
desc: M4 vehicle-driving fodder - the chase enemy. Drives a corrupted Vord cart and pursues the player. Validates driver AI (path-follow, pursue, collision avoidance) and gunner AI (aim while moving). Spawned by a simple director that rolls for a raid encounter when the player drives on a road.
appearance: Vord Drone variant with reinforced shoulder armor and a bandolier of crude bullets. Crouches behind the cart's frame while gunner-seated.
behaviors: Drives a Vord Cart along roads.
Pursues player vehicles within sight range.
Fires a primitive rifle from the gunner seat while in motion.
Disengages when its vehicle is below 30% HP.
abilities: Drive (pursue) - simple path-following AI on roads
Mounted Fire - inaccurate but persistent shots from the cart
Ramming - collides with player vehicle if direct line

name: Graze
desc: M3 passive wildlife. Peaceful herd animal. Drops raw_meat - feeds the combat sandbox AND the synergy sandbox (Combustible_Wet in a boiler reduces efficiency; can be smoked/dried into jerky at the Drying Rack).
appearance: Stocky four-legged grazer with thick brown fur. Long muzzle, gentle eyes, curved horns. Hooves leave clear prints in soft soil.
behaviors: Travels in herds of 4-8.
Flees if attacked or approached aggressively.
Tameable in later milestones (M2 acceptance only needs the kill-and-drop loop).

name: Cluck
desc: M2 passive wildlife - critical for the synergy sandbox. Lays eggs. Can be milked (the canonical 'weird path' interaction; future cow replaces this). Drops the milk that fuels the milk-in-boiler discovery.
appearance: Round body, short legs, fluffy feathers in mottled grey-brown. Tiny eyes, big appetite.
behaviors: Stays close to where it spawned.
Easy to catch by hand.
Lays eggs in nests if kept in Animal Pen (M2 has no pen yet - eggs drop on the ground at a low rate).
Can be 'milked' - lore-bending placeholder for the future cow.

name: Thornback
desc: M3 aggressive wildlife - the one hostile non-Vord creature in the Core build. Pack hunter. Required for the combat-feels-good test: a hostile that bites back and isn't an enemy boss.
appearance: Quadruped with bristling spine of bone spikes. Reptilian skin. Hooked tail.
behaviors: Hunts in packs of 3-4.
Charges at the player from concealment.
Reacts to hit with flinch; ragdolls on death.
drops: Sharp Bone Tip x2-3 (future ammo material)
